Mycelium · card editor

Review & edit card costs and descriptions

Every in-game card (archived cards are hidden), shown on its real face. Change any buy / play cost or the description & flavour — the face updates live and edited fields glow amber. Leave a comment on a card for anything beyond text/cost (a mechanic tweak, an art change). Everything saves in this browser. When done, either Download cards.json and drop it over docs/cards.json (then node scripts/gen-carddata.mjs && node build.mjs), or Copy changes (costs, text, and comments) and paste them back to Claude.
